source.name: Indie Hackers
source.subject: 璃・・What's New: $15k MRR in a boring niche, selling your internal tools, stop getting told what to do

raw_signal: $15k MRR in a boring niche / selling internal tools / vibe coding tools are gaining attention among indie builders.
buyer: Indie hackers, solo founders, vibe coders, and small software builders looking for proven small-business ideas.
pain: They do not know what to build, and they waste time chasing broad AI ideas instead of boring, specific, monetizable niches.
why_now: AI coding tools make it easier for solo builders to turn narrow workflow problems or internal tools into public products quickly.
first_product: A report or lightweight tool that converts real indie business signals into 10 buildable boring-niche SaaS ideas with buyer, pain, price, and validation plan.
price: $19-$29 one-time for a report, then $19-$49/month for ongoing access.
distribution: Indie Hackers, X, Product Hunt, Reddit r/SaaS, Reddit r/indiehackers, build-in-public accounts.
lead_magnet_angle: 10 boring AI SaaS ideas you can build this weekend.
content_angle: The best AI business ideas are not flashy. They are boring workflows with clear buyers.
bilion_access_angle: Bilion turns indie business signals into buildable product prompts, so builders stop guessing what to build.

raw_signal: AI-native email clients are emerging because inboxes now contain human conversations, SaaS notifications, AI-agent outputs, and workflow signals in one overloaded place.
buyer: Startup founders, operators, salespeople, consultants, newsletter-heavy creators, and AI builders drowning in email.
pain: Important opportunities are buried inside email noise. The inbox is no longer just a communication tool; it is an unstructured signal feed.
why_now: AI agents, SaaS notifications, and automated workflows are increasing inbox volume and complexity, creating demand for classification and extraction tools.
first_product: A manual Gmail paste-in tool that extracts business opportunities, buyer pain, product ideas, and content angles from selected newsletters and emails.
price: $9-$29/month, or $19 one-time for an inbox signal report.
distribution: Product Hunt, X, Indie Hackers, Gmail power-user communities, AI builder communities.
lead_magnet_angle: Find 10 business ideas hiding in your inbox.
content_angle: Your inbox is not email anymore. It is a business signal database.
bilion_access_angle: Bilion converts Gmail newsletters and startup emails into AI business opportunities and build prompts.

raw_signal: AI accounting is a high-demand category, but reliability, trust, and responsibility boundaries can break the product if the tool tries to replace expert review.
buyer: Solo founders, freelancers, small business owners, accountants, and bookkeeping firms.
pain: Bookkeeping, expense categorization, and tax preparation are painful, but users cannot afford serious mistakes.
why_now: AI can automate parts of bookkeeping, but buyers need review-first tools rather than fully autonomous accounting agents.
first_product: A tool that reviews transaction notes, receipts, and exports before they go to an accountant, flags missing information, and creates a clean handoff summary.
price: $19-$49/month for founders, or $99-$299/month for accountants managing multiple clients.
distribution: X, accountant communities, freelancer communities, small business newsletters, Japanese sole proprietor content.
lead_magnet_angle: AI accounting mistakes checklist for solo founders.
content_angle: The next AI accounting tool should not replace accountants. It should prepare cleaner inputs for them.
bilion_access_angle: Bilion does not just find product ideas. It also scores hype risk and failure risk before you build.

source.name: God of Prompt
source.subject: You don't have a Claude problem. You have a blank-chat problem.

raw_signal: AI users are not only blocked by model quality. They are blocked by blank-chat friction: not knowing what to ask, how to structure the task, or how to reuse workflows.
buyer: Claude users, ChatGPT users, AI beginners, creators, solo operators, and business owners trying to use AI repeatedly.
pain: They open AI tools but do not know what to type. They rewrite prompts from scratch and fail to create repeatable workflows.
why_now: AI skills, reusable prompt packs, and workflow templates are becoming a more understandable product format than abstract prompt engineering.
first_product: A pack of reusable AI skills for business builders: idea validation, offer creation, landing page drafting, DM writing, content generation, and build prompt creation.
price: Free starter pack, then $19-$29 for the complete pack.
distribution: Gumroad, X, beehiiv, Reddit AI communities, Claude communities, AI beginner audiences.
lead_magnet_angle: 10 AI skills that remove the blank-chat problem.
content_angle: You do not have an AI problem. You have a blank-product problem.
bilion_access_angle: Bilion turns vague AI business ideas into reusable build, content, and monetization workflows.

source.name: Liam Ottley
source.subject: $28k AI Contract Without Quitting His Job

raw_signal: AI agency education is selling the story that full-time employees can use Claude Code and limited spare time to close high-ticket AI implementation contracts.
buyer: Full-time workers, aspiring AI agency owners, consultants, non-technical operators, and people who want high-ticket AI service income.
pain: They believe they do not have enough time, technical skill, or confidence to sell AI implementation services.
why_now: Claude Code and similar tools compress build time, making AI implementation offers feel accessible to people with limited time.
first_product: A tool or report that generates niche-specific AI agency offers, scopes, pricing, outreach scripts, and 48-hour validation tasks.
price: $29 for an offer pack, $99 for a workshop, $299-$999 for a guided AI Product Opportunity Sprint.
distribution: X, Skool, YouTube shorts, AI agency communities, Japanese side-hustle audiences, LinkedIn.
lead_magnet_angle: 5 AI agency offers you can pitch this weekend.
content_angle: AI side income does not start with building a tool. It starts with a narrow paid implementation offer.
bilion_access_angle: Bilion helps users turn market signals into offers, build prompts, and outreach scripts instead of random AI tool ideas.
